WOODS.note: 跑图 11-21:东南路口往西南的路直接扎进河里(没桥、河不可走),改成在岸边草地里自然收住
WOODS.what: the dirt road coming from the upper right must end naturally on this side of the stream: it narrows and fades into the grass a short distance before the rocky bank and never touches the water. Keep the stream, rocks and bank exactly as they are.

WOODS.note: 同上,对岸那段路的起点
WOODS.what: the dirt road coming from the bottom must start naturally in the grass a short distance before the rocky bank: it narrows and fades out and never touches the water. Keep the stream, rocks and bank exactly as they are.
